title: Amazing Buttery American Tofu Skillet
description: A buttery and molten American dish featuring gherkin relish and spherified tofu, perfect for a plant-based brunch, this skillet is a delightful combination of flavors and textures that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and stir in the gherkin relish.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, sodium alginate, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Slowly pour the flour mixture into the skillet, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Use a spoon to create small spheres of the mixture and add the cooked tofu back into the skillet.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
